notes: Roles: development = rules were tuned on it; holdout = written independently, first run frozen as a baseline; unseen = third-party app run once, untouched, before any related fix (pre-adaptation).
LOC counts only the application's own PHP files that C3 analyses (bundled third-party libraries excluded).
Coverage gap: no benchmark application uses ENUM/SET columns or PDO. ENUM/SET handling and PDO query/prepare/exec are covered only by independently written fixtures and unit tests.

Third-party sources are not committed (see .gitignore). Re-create them with: git clone <url> benchmarks/apps/<name>; git -C benchmarks/apps/<name> checkout <commit>; then python benchmarks/tools/make_app_only_copy.py benchmarks/apps/<name> benchmarks/apps/_app_only/<name> --exclude <excluded_directories>.
